title: Icon Library (Libraries)

scenarios.title: Icon Library applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Icon Library (BtnIconBrowser) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Icon search filtering, ordering, cache and parsing pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production browser kernel pins: facet filters (collection, theme, style) compose case-insensitively with the favorites flag; the text needle is trimmed and lower-cased before matching over the computed SearchText (name, ids, categories, tags); the result ordering is Name then Style; a null catalog behaves like an empty one; the manifest cache is keyed by path+stamp (same key reuses, newer stamp reloads, Invalidate forces a reload); and the manifest parser tolerates null/blank input with the clone being deep.
